ns2:course.label: Choreographic Process I
ns2:course.description: Theory and practice in principles of dance composition; emphasis on solo creative work using various approaches to composition. Culmination of the semester's inquiry and activities will result in a solo or small ensemble work performed as part of the departmental Sophomore Review process. Prerequisite: Concurrent enrollment is required in DANC 259. For Dance majors only.
